description: Work Shouldn’t Break YouMy first job was as a paperboy. I rode my bike through the neighborhood each afternoon, tossing newspapers onto porches and getting to know the people who lived behind those front doors. Once a week, I’d go house to house, collecting their subscription money in person.It taught me a lot. Responsibility. Showing up.
